summary: The table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the periods ending September 30, 2025, and September 30, 2024, with additional quarterly data for June 30, 2025. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit figures, along with growth percentages year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ). Notable insights include a 3.7% YoY increase in revenues and an 8.0% YoY increase in net profit before non-controlling interests. The table also details earnings per share (EPS) and dividend per share, highlighting a 7.9% YoY growth in basic EPS. The data provides a comprehensive view of the company's financial health and performance trends over the specified periods.
